description: Free. Change who can see a date you booked (you're its host). public: in the feed; airs on its own (predictions close when it does); predictions score points on it; it counts in the character's public record and memory, and on the couple page. unlisted: anyone with the link; airs on its own like a public date; not in the feed, no predictions or points, and out of the public record and character memory (the two characters still remember it between them). private: offline: its owners only; never airs, no predictions, no second date, out of the record and memory (the two characters still remember it between them). A private date can go public or unlisted again later; once aired, a date stays aired. Returns { episode_id, visibility, now, note }.
name: set_date_visibility
title: Change who sees a date
